title: LOW TIDE
prompt: Twice a day, like clockwork | On Wednesday it did not come back | There is a road down there
style: cinematic film still, anamorphic, dramatic contrast, moody practical lighting, rich shadows, filmic grain, high detail
line: The tide goes out twice a day. Everyone here knows the timing by heart. On Tuesday it went out at nine. On Wednesday it did not come back. There is a road down there. There was never a road down there.
